 Weekly Recap: PAT +26%, loan growth and FCNR(B) ₹55,000cr pressures margins
 Less than 1 min read KOTAKBANK Kotak Mahindra Bank Limited (NSE:KOTAKBANK) reported Q2 consolidated PAT of Rs 5,645cr (+26% YoY) as NII grew 16% to Rs 8,459cr and advances/deposits rose sharply, though margins were compressed after mobilising ₹55,000cr FCNR(B) deposits while provisions fell and other income gained. 
 Previous Week Recap 
 Kotak Mahindra Bank Limited: Strong Q2 PAT Growth : KOTAKBANK Q2: consolidated PAT Rs 5,645cr (+26% YoY); NII Rs 8,459cr (+16%); NIMs 4.31%; net advances +25% to Rs 5.77Lcr; deposits +23% to Rs 6.51Lcr; GNPA 1.04%, NNPA 0.24%. 
 3 sources 
 KOTAKBANK Margin Pressure From FCNR Deposits : Kotak Mahindra Bank (KOTAKBANK) saw margin compression this quarter after mobilising ₹55,000 crore in FCNR(B) deposits, impacting interest margins. 
 Economic Times 
 KOTAKBANK Cuts Provisions; Income Rises : KOTAKBANK cut loan loss provisions 15% to ₹8.04B; other income rose 23% to ₹31.94B on bond and investment gains amid currency and debt-market volatility. 
 Mint 
 Kotak Mahindra Bank Live Q2 Earnings Call : Kotak Mahindra Bank (KOTAKBANK) hosts Q2 2027 earnings call live; results were presented in real time and available to follow on TradingView (mobile app lacked live call support).
